```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sock-shop
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: front-end
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 8079
    targetPort: 8079
  selector:
    name: front-end
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: front-end
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: front-end
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: front-end
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: front-end
        image: weaveworksdemos/front-end:0.3.12
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8079
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: edge-router
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  - name: management
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    name: edge-router
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: edge-router
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: edge-router
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: edge-router
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: edge-router
        image: weaveworksdemos/edge-router:0.1.1
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            add:
            - NET_BIND_SERVICE
            - CHOWN
            - SETGID
            - SETUID
            - DAC_OVERRIDE
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        - containerPort: 8080
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run
          name: tmpfs-var-run
      volumes:
      - name: tmpfs-var-run
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
---
```
